discussion_comments.comment_body:
This IPv6 check — and the existing `=== "::1"` on line 23 — never matches. `URL.hostname` returns IPv6 literals **with brackets**, so the real values are `"[::]"` / `"[::1]"`:

```js
new URL("http://[::1]/").hostname // => "[::1]"
new URL("http://[::]/").hostname  // => "[::]"
```

So both equality checks are dead code and IPv6 loopback/unspecified hosts aren't actually blocked. Suggest stripping brackets before comparing (e.g. `const h = lowerHost.replace(/^\[|\]$/g, "")`), and ideally also covering `fc00::/7`, `fe80::/10`, and IPv4-mapped `::ffff:169.254.169.254`.
